messages:
Maya (AE): Opening MistralPort swap thread. Prospect expects minimal client changes, strict parity for three reconciliation workflows, and a clear billing trace per request. SE + Sec + Pricing please advise.

Jordan (SE): Quick context: they call a synchronous /v1/complete endpoint via gRPC today, ~350k tokens/day, a mix of short (20-80 tok) and medium (200-600 tok) prompts. They flagged tokenization differences and retry rounding as primary causes of billing deltas.

Cecilia (MistralPort Eng): We have 3 regulatory flows that must reconcile to the cent. Any per-request token diff >1% triggers an audit. We also use strict deterministic templates for filings. We need a sandbox, IP allowlist, and a shim example to adapt gRPC->REST if needed.

Jordan (SE): Plan: 1) Provide a thin adapter mapping their gRPC payload to Redwood /responses JSON so no client library change. 2) Run parity harness: token accounting diff, tokenizer alignment (we can run tokenizers side-by-side), exact-match checks for the deterministic templates, and semantic sim for the rest. 3) Supply per-request trace logs (request_id, input_hash, tokens_in/out) so they can reconcile billing.

Jordan (SE): Adapter snippet (concept):
```bash
# translate gRPC payload to REST for quick test
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"{{text}}","model":"redwood-stable-1","max_tokens":{{max}}}'
```

Arun (Security): BYOK/KMS: available on Dedicated and Private. Hosted uses envelope encryption; BYOK on Hosted is not supported today. SSO/SCIM: supported for console. Audit logs retention: default 90d masked; can extend on Dedicated with contractual terms. We'll need their security questionnaire and allowlist CIDRs.

Tess (Pricing): Ballpark hosted generation: $0.006 / 1k tokens. For their mix Dedicated reserve estimate: ~$28k/month for 6mo commit; 12mo gives deeper discounts. We can produce a line-item comparison if they share last 90 days usage. Also note: per-request trace export to their S3 is an add-on.

Cecilia (MistralPort Eng): Acceptance criteria from our auditing team: 1) Deterministic suite (50 templates) -> exact byte-for-byte match. 2) Token accounting delta <=1% across 2k prompts. 3) Semantic sim >=0.95 for non-deterministic set. 4) Request trace present and matches our hashes. 5) p95 latency <350ms on Dedicated for short prompts. 6) No silent truncation on retries.

Jordan (SE): We'll run a 200-prompt smoke tonight, then full 2k during the POC week. We'll include tokenizer side-by-side outputs in the report. We'll also provide a small shim repo and a runbook.

ops-bot: staging environment for mistralport-poc available at https://staging.redwood.ai/mistralport (id: 6098). egress IPs: 34.210.99.18, 34.210.99.19.

Cecilia (MistralPort Eng): Got the sandbox link. Sending golden templates + 2k sample set via secure transfer.

Arun (Security): I'll prefill the vendor questionnaire and flag BYOK/retention items for legal review. Also we should confirm whether per-request traces will include masked PII by default.

Tess (Pricing): I'll prepare two scenarios (hosted monthly vs 12mo Dedicated) and show savings if they enable prefix caching + batching. Also will include cost for trace export and any PS for BYOK setup.

Maya (AE): Scheduling 30m sync with MistralPort + SE + Sec + Pricing tomorrow 10:30am PT. Agenda: acceptance criteria, tokenization checks, pricing scenarios, and next steps for allowlisting.

Jordan (SE): I'll drop the adapter repo and a minimal runbook here after the thread so they can start the smoke tonight. :thumbsup:

Maya (AE): Marking CRM: mistralport-swap-poc. Will update after kickoff. :rocket:
